subject: Re: OpenMSD kickoff - the multilingual science corpus, at full scale
body:
Dmitri,

Plan:

Staffing - Rosa 60% (pipeline lead: the OpenCitations COCI ingest and the CrossRef json.gz decode path), Saoirse 40% (validation + datasheet tooling), Gustavo 30% (relation extraction QA - he's stretched across teams this spring so I've scoped him narrowly).

Storage - I've requested 1.5 TB working space on the batch tier: ~425 GB raw inputs, the rest for intermediates and the joined output. CPU-only, no GPU ask at all.

Corpus coordination - the handoff lands May 29, but we'll want two heavy ingestion reruns after that as the upstream dumps refresh. I checked the migration calendar: Corpus v2's migration freeze is 2026-07-24, so scheduling the two heavy ingestion reruns for early July still leaves us two clear weeks of margin before the freeze. I've booked the batch capacity for the weeks of July 6 and July 13 accordingly.

Bruno
